answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a $50 deposit in a vault before trading and proves control of its cipher key at sign-up. The deposit returns on a glacier-slow schedule, one tenth per epoch, and burns if the identity duplicates work or votes twice. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000 up front, far more than those fakes could earn. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes, so honesty is cheaper.
